title: Cookie Management & Tracking Prevention Request Letter Template
metaDescription: Free template to request cookie deletion and tracking prevention from websites. Protect your privacy with this professional letter format.
description: Use this professional letter template to formally request websites and companies to delete stored cookies, stop third-party tracking, and respect your privacy preferences. Includes all necessary legal language and customizable sections.

sections.heading: Letter Header
sections.content:
[Your Name]
[Your Address]
[City, State, ZIP Code]
[Your Email]
[Your Phone Number]

[Date]

[Company Name]
[Privacy Officer/Data Protection Officer]
[Company Address]
[City, State, ZIP Code]

sections.heading: Subject Line
sections.content:
Subject: Request for Cookie Deletion and Tracking Prevention
Reference: Cookie Management and Privacy Protection Request

sections.heading: Opening Statement
sections.content:
Dear Privacy Officer,

I am writing to formally request the deletion of all cookies and tracking data associated with my visits to your website(s) and to opt out of all future tracking activities. This request is made under applicable privacy laws and regulations, including but not limited to GDPR, CCPA, and other consumer privacy protections.

sections.heading: Specific Requests
sections.content:
I hereby request that your organization:

1. Delete all cookies, tracking pixels, and similar technologies currently stored on my devices from your website
2. Remove all behavioral tracking data associated with my browsing activities
3. Discontinue all third-party data sharing related to my website interactions
4. Implement a 'Do Not Track' preference for my future visits
5. Provide confirmation that these actions have been completed
6. Honor my cookie preferences going forward without requiring repeated requests

sections.heading: Technical Details
sections.content:
This request applies to all tracking technologies including but not limited to:
- First-party and third-party cookies
- Session and persistent cookies
- Advertising cookies and tracking pixels
- Browser fingerprinting techniques
- Cross-site tracking mechanisms
- Analytics and performance cookies (unless essential for website functionality)

I understand that essential cookies necessary for website functionality may remain active during my visits.

sections.heading: Account Information
sections.content:
If applicable, please locate my data using the following information:
- Website account email: [Your Email]
- Account username: [Username if applicable]
- Approximate dates of website visits: [Date range]

If you cannot locate my data using this information, please apply this request to all visitors from my IP address range during the specified time period.

sections.heading: Legal Basis
sections.content:
This request is made under my rights as a consumer to:
- Control personal data collection and processing
- Withdraw consent for non-essential tracking
- Request deletion of personal information
- Opt out of the sale or sharing of personal information

Please treat this as a formal privacy request under applicable laws in my jurisdiction.

sections.heading: Response Timeline
sections.content:
Please acknowledge receipt of this request within 5 business days and provide a complete response within 30 days as required by applicable privacy laws. If you need additional time or information to process this request, please contact me promptly.

I would appreciate confirmation in writing (via email) once you have completed these actions.

sections.heading: Closing
sections.content:
Thank you for your attention to this privacy matter. I look forward to your prompt response and confirmation that my cookie management preferences have been implemented.

For future browsing, I will be using privacy-focused browsers like Incognito Browser to better control tracking and cookie management.

Sincerely,

[Your Signature]
[Your Printed Name]

useCases: Requesting cookie deletion from websites after browsing sessions
Opting out of third-party advertising tracking networks
Formal privacy requests to e-commerce sites and online services
Following up on failed automatic cookie opt-out attempts
Requesting tracking prevention for sensitive browsing activities
Corporate privacy compliance requests for employee browsing
Educational institutions managing student privacy on school websites
